children: Overview
Hong Kong hotel operator's yearly revenue was HK$127.5 mln, net profit declined 5.6% yr/yr
Net profit decline mainly due to unrealised fair value loss on financial instrument
Company recommended final dividend, total dividend for year maintained at HK3.0 cents per share
Outlook
Company says Hong Kong tourism outlook remains positive with rising visitor numbers
Sino Hotels expects continued recovery in hospitality business and effectiveness of operational strategies
Company will continue to review investment holdings prudently for sustainable long-term growth
Result Drivers
FAIR VALUE LOSS - Net profit decline was mainly due to an unrealised fair value loss on a financial instrument
TOURISM RECOVERY - Company said increased visitor arrivals and higher room rates supported performance
COST CONTROL - Co said disciplined cost management and operational strategies helped maintain efficiency
